description:
Cast Time Stretch from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Talon Gates of Madara by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out Hades.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand.
During your first extra turn, Hades phases in during your untap step.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

uses.name: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld
uses.cardState: on the battlefield as Hades, Sorcerer of Eld
